Well versed with MS Excel, Jira, Mind Maps and SQL. Should be Detail-oriented, strong analytical and communication skills are a must. Ability to synthesize large amounts of information, and a curiosity to ask appropriate questions to fully develop business and functional requirements. Knowledge of software development life cycle Agile experience Understating of programing languages like Java, Python will be added advantage.
